scope: source-independent harness and fixture specification only

mutation_observation_contract.before_read: Read the current identified resource, revision, cursor and relevant unchanged fields through the owning consumer.
mutation_observation_contract.action: Invoke the declared public command when available; until then execute only the explicit fixture-only binding.
mutation_observation_contract.fresh_after_read: Reconnect or use a fresh reader and verify the observable result independently of cached input.
mutation_observation_contract.persisted_delta: Compare the exact intended state delta with preserved unrelated state.
mutation_observation_contract.event_receipt: Correlate the semantic event and receipt by stable request identity.
mutation_observation_contract.replay: Exercise same-key replay and conflicting replay with explicit rejection/no-collateral-mutation outcomes.
mutation_observation_contract.restart_recovery: Restart or reconnect where material and verify committed state, history, uncertainty and cursor recovery.
